capabilities: Upload handwritten or sketch photos from the filesystem or via QR code from a phone
Group images into inline PDF-style carousels inside notes
Add optional text annotations to images for search
Insert carousels via the 'Insert Napkin Notes' command
Configure attachment folder and optional napkin texture
extras: Camera/QR upload requires the phone and computer to be on the same wifi network; some phones may hit a low-memory error with camera capture. Mobile only supports filesystem (gallery) upload.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get physical handwritten or whiteboard notes into a vault as organized, searchable inline images, especially when handwriting is too messy for OCR.
summary: Handwritten-note capture plugin that turns note, sketch, and whiteboard photos into inline PDF-style image carousels with searchable annotations.
